content:
alex_sales: Hey @marie_se @devin_eng — big prospect (healthcare, fully disconnected DC) wants to run a week-long POC. Can we confirm the on-prem/air-gapped checklist they need: bundle packaging, upgrade cadence options, offline license activation, signing/trust model, rollback & support window? Any immediate blockers?

marie_se: short answer: yes, doable but there are ops/security caveats. We have an offline bundle flow and offline activation tokens. Need to confirm whether the customer wants models baked into the bundle or referenced separately. Also: telemetry/usage collection will be disabled — ensure acceptance tests don't rely on outbound.

devin_eng: Technical notes: we can produce a tarball with images + manifests. Base platform bundle (no model weights) ~6–12GB. If they want a model included (Llama-like 30–70GB or larger), that gets much bigger. Recommend shipping model as separate staged artifact. For upgrades: we support full-bundle replace or delta patches if customer agrees to run our patcher. Delta patches usually 200–800MB depending on change.

fred_security: Security checklist: signed bundle manifest (SHA256), SBOM for all containers, offline signature verification path must work without external CA fetches. Time/clock skew: offline activation should be tolerant of no NTP. Confirm whether customer requires customer-managed KMS/HSM for signing or if our signing and verification is enough.

alex_sales: They asked specifically about upgrade cadence — they're comfortable with monthly security patches but want a pinned release with backports for 12+ months. Is that supported? Also asking if we can guarantee rollback to previous image quickly.

devin_eng: Yes: pinned-release + security backports is an enterprise option (requires SOW). Rollback: we support image-level rollback; with delta patches you can revert, but the safest is full image replace. We'll include a rollback test in the POC checklist.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INF-8342 for airgapped bundle automation + acceptance checklist (assign to devin_eng, marie_se)

marie_se: Licensing/activation: we do one-time offline activation tokens. Sales requests token via portal -> signed activation file -> customer uploads via console or CLI. We'll need to confirm ordering process (sales PO vs portal request). Also capture acceptance criteria for the POC: successful install, offline activation, run smoke tests, validate rollback.

devin_eng: Quick install example to share with customer for POC:
```
# copy bundle to appliance
./redwood-install.sh --bundle /mnt/media/redwood-bundle.tar.gz --activate-token activation-XXXXX
systemctl start redwood.service
redwoodctl status --wait 60
```
Make sure they run on a node with at least 32GB RAM for base services; models need additional GPU/RAM requirements.

fred_security: Also note: provide attestation for binary signature and an SBOM. Legal may flag export controls if we include some model weights — flag this early. I'll coordinate with Legal.

alex_sales: Great. Can you estimate lead time so I can put realistic dates in the SOW?

devin_eng: Est: 2 weeks to produce a tailored bundle + docs and run initial internal acceptance. 4–6 weeks to build delta-update automation + signing workflow for repeated patches. If model-included, add another 1–2 weeks depending on licensing and packaging windows.

marie_se: I'll add acceptance criteria to INF-8342 and draft the POC checklist: bundle delivery, offline activation validated, SBOM + signatures provided, rollback test passed, and security questionnaire items answered.

alex_sales: Perfect — I'll update the customer and follow up with a draft SOW. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
